name: Eastern gray squirrel
introduction: Meet the voice behind the bushy tail. Explore a field recording of a lone gray squirrel and listen closely to its calls.

sounds.title: A squirrel calling
sounds.description: A lone gray squirrel recorded in Camberley, Surrey, England, on July 31, 1977. Listen for the rhythm and texture of its voice against the surrounding sounds.
sounds.credit: Recorded by Aubrey John Williams. © The British Library Board. Shelfmark W1CDR0001470 BD12. If supplied as MP3, format converted from the published Ogg recording; no editorial changes intended.
